title: 雨后茶寮 / After the rain
purpose: Art-direction reference for Blender MCP model and real-time Hilo3D scene. Not used as a replacement background/render.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production concept preview for a real-time 3D Blender-made Hilo3D showcase, landscape 16:10.
Primary request: a beautiful fresh Japanese anime-inspired small tea-house garden after rain, a coherent scene that can be faithfully built as real 3D geometry.
Scene: one compact architectural garden diorama, softly bevelled pale stone island base resting against a clean misty pale-blue backdrop. A small cream plaster and warm cedar timber Japanese tea house, teal/mint pitched tiled roof with prominent individually modelled curved roof tiles and dark teal ridge caps. Its open front veranda has exposed wooden posts, delicate lattice sliding windows, warm interior counter, tiny ceramic tea set, coral-pink noren curtains and a hanging round cream paper lantern. A circular gable/window motif and a small wooden hanging shop plaque with a simple leaf symbol, NO text.
A shallow clear turquoise pond occupies the front-right, rounded stone edge, 3 stepping stones across it, a couple of lily pads. A gently arched short cedar bridge connects the veranda to the front path. On the left, one elegant small cherry-blossom tree with visible curved branch silhouette and airy sculpted pale pink blossom clusters. Lavender/blue hydrangeas and sculpted rounded mint-green shrubs frame the island; a few peach petals on the stepping-stone path. A slender glass wind chime under the eave; a trace of tea steam. Main building, tree, bridge, and water all readable with breathing room, restrained amount of detail.
Style/medium: premium stylized 3D environment with the inviting atmosphere of a contemporary hand-painted Japanese anime background; crisp graceful silhouettes, matte pastel materials, subtle color variation, fine bevel highlights, no harsh black outlines. A polished game environment render, NOT a flat watercolor illustration.
Composition/framing: centered 3/4 perspective, entire diorama visible, camera slightly elevated about 23 degrees looking toward the open front and right side, medium focal length, scene fills around 82% of frame, full base visible, no cuts. Building upper center-left, pond front-right, blossom tree left/back. Keep a clear pleasing diagonal from foreground stones through the bridge to the tea counter.
Lighting/mood: clear soft morning light after rain, pale warm sun from upper-left, gentle blue sky fill, pastel bounced light under the veranda, delicate sun shafts through tree branches, soft contact shadows, translucent pond and glass. Bright fresh optimistic peaceful atmosphere. Natural HDR light softly tone mapped, preserve detail in highlights and deep veranda.
Constraints: one coherent main-view concept, geometrically plausible small building, objects visibly separate for modelling. No people, no modern machinery, no overgrown fantasy ruins, no text, no UI, no grid, no technical labels, no watermarks, no inset views, no excessive depth of field.
